about_the_game:
Copy Two Man Too Many is a 2D psychological game with an isometric view. Explore the gloomy building of a psychiatric hospital, where you are trapped. Solve logic puzzles. Dive deep into the dark story to uncover the mystery and get out of the hospital.

The game tells the story of 1st November 1993, at the closed St. Valentine Mental Health Hospital. The player takes on the role of a character showing signs of amnesia who decides to escape from an ill-fated facility. It involves participating in a dangerous game where the rules will turn the reality into hell as it soon becomes clear that the hospital walls are not the biggest obstacle to overcome. The player will find and use various items, talk to other characters, explore the hospital building, and avoid detection by the staff. The uncovered elements of the mystery will pose moral dilemmas to the player and force him to behave irrationally in order to escape from the hospital.

Shadows, sounds of the storm and gloomy music create a dark atmosphere. The game's seven levels will challenge logical thinking, perseverance and perceptiveness. Some items may be in different places, making the game always run differently.

The game has a black and white, minimalist graphic design.
